fusions.name: Sluggish Cut
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 5 damage and has a 40% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stilled Swing
fusions.desc: A broad swing that deals 13 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Basking Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a ward worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
